title: Long NVDA — Conditional on PPI Soft + Warsh Balanced (BUY Upgrade Trigger)
entry: $209–$217. Enter ONLY if June PPI prints ≤-0.1% MoM at 8:30 AM ET AND Warsh Senate testimony (10 AM ET) does not flag July 28–29 FOMC as a live meeting. Entry at 9:31 AM ET open in this BUY upgrade scenario. If PPI prints ≥flat MoM OR Warsh signals July is live, DO NOT ENTER — the HOLD/STEP ASIDE regime makes this conditional long immediately invalid. NVDA is pre-market at ~$212, testing the intraday high from yesterday on ASML beat-and-raise confirmation of AI demand. A PPI soft print removes the September hike risk that is keeping NVDA below $220.
stop_loss: $198 daily close (~6.6% below $212 entry reference). Implies either: (1) PPI printed soft but Warsh escalated the language at Senate, causing rate re-pricing that reverses the morning's bull catalyst; (2) WTI breaks $80 intraday and Iran trip wire is triggered — September hike probability rises above 60%, re-compressing NVDA's AI multiple; (3) TSMC Q2 (July 16) disappoints on H2 guidance, removing the AI wafer demand floor that ASML's beat confirmed. A $198 close is 7.5% below the $214 entry midpoint — wider than typical to account for the conditional entry structure.
targets: $225 — September hike probability falls to 25–30% on PPI soft + Warsh balanced; NVDA tests the June 5 pre-FOMC high; AI multiple re-expands from 38x to 41x forward earnings on relief; cover 40% of position; +6.1% from $212 reference

$238 — TSMC Q2 (July 16) guides H2 capex above $22B AND NVDA's H200 China shipment approval (already in progress per FX Leaders July 15 reporting) generates a buyable China revenue upgrade; cover 40% of remaining position; +12.3% from reference

$252 — NVDA Q2 FY27 pre-earnings drift (report August 26); September hike probability is at or below 20%; AI capex cycle validation across ASML/TSM/NVDA triple-confirmation drives index-level multiple expansion; VIX below 13; final 20% as a tail-end hold through earnings; +18.9% from reference
risk_reward: 1:2.6 to Target 3 (conditional on PPI trigger; undefined risk if condition not met — do not enter)
catalyst: June PPI (8:30 AM ET July 15, consensus -0.1% MoM / 6.2% YoY) is the binary trigger. A ≤-0.1% MoM print confirms the disinflationary pipeline is intact — the June CPI beat (3.5% YoY, six-year best) was not a fluke. September rate hike probability would fall from 44.5% to approximately 25–30% on a PPI soft print, releasing the multiple compression that has held NVDA below $220 despite ASML's Q2 beat-and-raise this morning confirming AI hardware demand. The BUY upgrade scenario (PPI ≤-0.1% AND Warsh balanced AND WTI holds below $80) is the morning briefing's explicit trigger for adding NVDA.
thesis:
NVDA at $212 pre-market is a rate story masquerading as an AI story. The AI fundamentals are unambiguously strong: ASML's Q2 beat-and-raise (€9.3B, raised guide to €43–45B) this morning eliminates the demand-side bear case. NVDA's H200 China shipments are reportedly moving through customs (FX Leaders July 15), adding a revenue layer that was absent from consensus. NVDA Q2 FY27 earnings on August 26 have a whisper number above $40B — approximately 30% above the $30.8B buy-side consensus — implying the stock is structurally cheap at 38x forward earnings if the AI infrastructure cycle sustains.

The constraint has been purely macro: September rate hike probability at 44.5% injects enough uncertainty into long-duration tech multiples that institutional money is holding cash rather than adding NVDA at $212. June CPI at 3.5% YoY reduced the hike probability from ~62% to 44.5% overnight — but the PPI release today is the second leg of the macro confirmation needed to fully clear the rate overhang. If PPI confirms the disinflationary pattern (producer prices falling at the wholesale level, matching the consumer-level surprise), September hike probability falls below 30% and the rate constraint on NVDA's multiple is structurally removed for the next 4–6 weeks.

The TSMC earnings (July 16) provide the third leg of confirmation. ASML's Q3 guide implies €11–12B of equipment revenues — which requires TSMC to be commissioning the equivalent of 10–12 new advanced node fab bays in H2 2026. If TSMC confirms H2 capex on schedule, the AI wafer demand signal from all three legs of the triangle — ASML (equipment), TSMC (wafer manufacturing), NVDA (end demand) — is complete. In that scenario, $238 becomes the base case before August earnings, not the bull case.

The conditional structure is essential. This is NOT a buy-and-hold NVDA position — it is a 2–4 week tactical long that depends on the macro regime staying in BUY (PPI soft + Warsh balanced). If WTI breaks $80 post-entry, the September hike trip wire is activated and the position should be reduced by 50% same day at market. The $198 stop is sized for the risk that both the macro and technical thesis are wrong simultaneously.
bull_case: PPI prints -0.2% MoM (beats even the consensus). Warsh Senate testimony is carbon copy of House testimony — opaque, no forward guidance, no July signal. WTI holds below $80. September hike probability falls to 22%. NVDA gaps to $218–$220 at 9:31 AM open and closes above $222 on the session. TSMC Q2 Thursday (July 16) beat and raised H2 capex confirms the triangle. NVDA drifts to $238+ in the two weeks between TSMC earnings and the July 29–30 FOMC.
bear_case: PPI prints flat or higher (+0.1% MoM) — the June CPI 'beat' is revealed as energy-driven with a persistent core problem. Warsh flags July 28–29 as a live meeting. September hike probability jumps back above 60%. NVDA reverses from $212 pre-market to $205 intraday as the macro overlay swamps the ASML AI demand signal. WTI hits $80.10 on Iran Naval news during the 10 AM Warsh testimony — simultaneous triggers across all three risk vectors. Exit position immediately if PPI condition fails at 8:30 AM.
invalidation: $198 NVDA daily close; OR PPI ≥flat MoM at 8:30 AM — do not enter at all; OR Warsh uses language indicating July 28–29 FOMC is a live meeting — exit any position taken on PPI conditions; OR WTI closes above $80 for the first time (September hike trip wire activated — reduce position 50% same session); OR TSMC Q2 (July 16) guides H2 capex below $20B (AI wafer demand floor removed).
